system.description: When the Bruid speaks the power's trigger word, Bolgemek, the ancient sacred spear of Adarik the Conqueror, appears in their hands. It vanishes in smoke when the power ends. This two-handed heavy spear deals 1d10 (OR 7-10) + 6 damage, has Protection Value 20, Integrity 200, Initiative Modifier -4, and 3 weapon actions. It grants its bearer +4 Protection Value, +2 SV for attacks and parries with the spear, and a further +2 SV to parry when outnumbered.
system.summary: Summons Bolgemek, the sacred two-handed spear of Adarik the Conqueror.
